description: Where the orphan-test check (TX25, D-070) looks for Python tests: every test it finds must be run by exactly one scripts/tests/*.test.sh wrapper.

test-orphans.skip_dirs.description: Directories under tests_dir that hold data, not tests: a test_*.py in them is a fixture and needs no wrapper.

test-orphans.test_glob.description: File name of a Python test, directly in tests_dir or in one module directory below it (the TX24 form <module>/test_*.py).

test-orphans.tests_dir.description: Directory of the Python tests and of their *.test.sh wrappers, relative to the repository root.
